segments.thag7.2:1.3: Samūlaṃ taṇhamabbuyha, tattha bhaddova jhāyati [bhaddo’ dhijhāyāyati (sī.), bhaddo jhiyāyati (syā. sī. aṭṭha.)].
segments.thag7.2:3.1: “Buddho ce [buddho ca (sabbattha)] me varaṃ dajjā, so ca labbhetha me varo;
segments.thag7.2:4.1: “Ye maṃ rūpena pāmiṃsu, ye ca ghosena anvagū;
segments.thag7.2:4.3: Chandarāgavasūpetā, na maṃ jānanti te janā.
segments.thag7.2:5.1: “Ajjhattañca na jānāti, bahiddhā ca na passati;
segments.thag7.2:5.3: Samantāvaraṇo bālo, sa ve ghosena vuyhati.
